summary: Delayed pin-commit window causing transient tenant reroutes during canary traffic windows
description: Issue summary: During a scheduled canary rollout for redwood-open-3b-v2, a subset of tenant traffic for FableChat observed transient reroutes to fallback variants for 2-5 minutes. Impact: occasional mixed-model outputs for live user sessions resulting in customer-reported quality regressions and a spike in 5xx/502s downstream. Environment: dedicated pool in us-east-1 with a pinned model setting on the tenant (pin expiry configured to commit after health probes).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer pins tenant X to redwood-open-3b-v2 and initiates a canary weight shift from 0%->10% over 5m.
2) Observe routing coordinator logs during the weight shift and the pin-commit window (health probe + commit delay).
3) Send steady request stream from a single tenant session token for 10 minutes and watch for variant changes and 502 spikes.
logs: Edge logs: repeated 502 from route-coordinator (route-coordinator/connmgr) at 2026-03-10T12:22:11Z - 'pin commit timeout: waiting for prewarm'.
Routing coordinator: INFO pin-commit-scheduled tenant=X commit_at=2026-03-10T12:21:30Z
Routing coordinator: WARN pin-commit-delayed tenant=X reason=health-probe-lag observed_live_prepared=2 expected=3
Serving runtime: WARN kv-cache-miss and model-variant-fallback invoked for session token tn-93b at 2026-03-10T12:24:05Z
customer_reported_symptoms: Intermittent unexpected responses from older model during live chat sessions
User-visible hallucinations correlating with fallback periods
Elevated 502 counts in customer monitoring around canary windows
comments: 2026-03-10 12:45 - Priya Patel: Initial report received from FableChat CS. They attached a sample conversation where responses flip between two model styles.
2026-03-10 13:05 - Jordan Lee: Triage done. Suspect delayed pin commit interacting with prewarm/health-probe threshold logic. Assigning to routing and serving-runtime oncall.
2026-03-10 14:30 - SRE (Marta Gomez): Observed health-probe jitter in us-east under scheduled autoscale event, some prewarm instances failed readiness checks causing commit to stall.

2026-03-11 09:10 - Eng (Evan Park): Reproduced in staging using traffic replay with artificially slowed health probe. Confirmed commit window extends and coordinator routes to fallback when expected prewarm < threshold.
2026-03-12 11:00 - Jordan Lee: Mitigation applied: shortened commit window config for affected pool and increased prewarm concurrency. Monitoring for recurrence.
2026-03-12 11:15 - Priya Patel: Notified customer of temporary mitigation. Customer reported reduced incidents after change but asked for durable fix timeline.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Pin-commit logic requires N healthy prewarmed workers before flipping traffic; if readiness reports are delayed, the coordinator falls back to default variant causing mixed outputs.
Hypothesis 2: Edge-proxy retry/backoff interacts with the delayed commit and causes session tokens to be rehomed mid-commit leading to session-affinity split.
Evidence: Correlated timestamps show pin-commit-scheduled -> pin-commit-delayed -> fallback-route-invoked within a 3-minute window. Prewarm failures coincide with autoscale events.
Repro steps validated in staging by injecting 300ms health-probe latency which produced the same transient reroutes within the canary window.
Related code area: route-coordinator commit state machine + healthcheck gating logic (see PR 478).
action_items: A1: Short-term config change applied to reduce commit wait timeout in the affected dedicated pool (done 2026-03-12 11:00).
A2: Patch route-coordinator to treat slow readiness as degraded but allow controlled phased commit when prewarm meets lower bound (engineering follow-up, PR in progress).
A3: Add observability signal and alert for 'pin-commit-delayed' so SRE can intervene before fallback happens.
A4: Postmortem and runbook update to include guidance for autoscale/prewarm interaction with pin-commit windows.
resolution: Mitigation: reduced commit window and increased prewarm concurrency for the dedicated pool; incidents dropped to baseline. Planned fix: route-coordinator change to allow conservative phased commit when prewarm count is marginal (engineering PR targeting 2026-03-19). Customer notified and will be alerted when fix deploys.
follow_up: Monitor for 72h and escalate if any recurrence: watch 'pin-commit-delayed' alert and 502 rates for tenant X.
Complete code patch and land PR 478 by 2026-03-19; schedule a canary deploy in low-traffic window.
Update runbook 'canary-routing-retries' with a section on pin-commit/prewarm interactions and checklist for SRE when autoscale events occur.
